notes: REWRITE of draft #40, written fresh; none of the old draft's numbers (NHRA ET-bracket sizes, 'SFI 25.5 renewed every 3 years', SCCA closed/open-car sizes, the old comparison table) were reused. SAFETY-CRITICAL. WebFetch had no DNS in the writing environment, so every rule statement was checked through search-index text restricted to the official domain (nhra.com/nhraracer.com, scca.com, nasaproracing.com, fia.com, sfifoundation.com). Please open the linked documents to confirm before publishing, especially: (1) NHRA 2017/2019 .118 mild steel / .083 4130 pairing, labelled as past editions, OD deliberately not tied to a class because the extracted text mixed 1-3/4 and 1-5/8 by section; (2) SCCA TT announcement 535 (1.25 x 0.090 up to 1,500 lb, Levels 2-3); the full SCCA TT weight table was garbled in the extract and is NOT quoted; (3) FIA 45x2.5 / 50x2.0 mm and 350 N/mm2 from the 2016-2021 editions; the 2026 edition (WMSC 23.06.2026) was not read; (4) NASA Spec 3 2026 mounting-point limit; (5) SFI 25.4D scope and July 2, 2021 effective date. SCCA GCR and NASA CCR 15.6 tube tables were seen only in forum quotes and are not stated. Metric-to-inch conversions are computed (45 mm = 1.772 in, 2.5 mm = .098 in, 50 mm = 1.969 in, 2.0 mm = .079 in).
